missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ведро' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. This neuter noun does not change in the nominative, and 'у двери' gives the location.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ведро' is the accusative direct object of 'несу'; neuter nouns look identical in nominative and accusative. 'Тяжёлое' agrees, and 'воды' is genitive after a container.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В ведре' uses the prepositional form 'ведре' after 'в' to locate the contents. 'Воды' is genitive after 'нет' for absence.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Ведра' is the genitive required after 'около' to mean near the bucket. 'Тряпка' is the nominative subject of 'лежит'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Ведро' is accusative after 'в' showing motion into the bucket. 'Молоко' is the accusative object being poured.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Ведром' is the instrumental case naming the tool we wash with. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental, and 'пол' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after two. 'Ведра' follows the numeral 'два', taking the genitive singular form. 'В углу' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural with ё. 'Вёдра' is the irregular nominative plural with a stressed ё, the subject of 'стоят'. 'Пустые' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative gift. 'Ведро' is the accusative direct object of 'дал'. 'Соседу' is the dative recipient, and 'новое' agrees with the neuter noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative request. 'Ведро' is the accusative direct object of the imperative 'принеси'. 'Мне' is the dative recipient in this polite request.
